name: OpenJKDF2 for iOS (unofficial)
subtitle: Jedi Knight and Mysteries of the Sith on iPhone and iPad
description:
An unofficial fan port of OpenJKDF2, the open-source Jedi Knight engine, to iPhone and iPad, with touch controls. Two apps: OpenJKDF2 for Star Wars Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II, and OpenMoTS for Mysteries of the Sith.

You need your own copy of each game (GOG or Steam). No game files are included.

It's a beta. Setup guide and bug reports: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/OpenJKDF2-iOS

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Lucasfilm, Disney or LucasArts, or by the OpenJKDF2 developers.

apps.name: OpenJKDF2
apps.developerName: OpenJKDF2 contributors, iOS port by sithewok13-dev
apps.subtitle: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II, with touch controls
apps.localizedDescription:
An unofficial fan port of OpenJKDF2 to iPhone and iPad: play Star Wars Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II (1997) with on-screen touch controls, a game controller or a keyboard, and multiplayer.

You need your own copy of the game (GOG or Steam); no game files are included. Open the app once, then copy the game's Episode, Resource and MUSIC folders into Files > On My iPhone > OpenJKDF2 > jk1.

It's a beta: expect bugs, and back up your saves.

Setup guide: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/OpenJKDF2-iOS/blob/HEAD/docs/ios/README.md

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Lucasfilm, Disney or LucasArts, or by the OpenJKDF2 developers.

versions.localizedDescription:
New since v0.8-beta1:
- Join games hosted by the original 1997 Jedi Knight
- Easier-to-read multiplayer menus
- New lightsaber colours (REFORGED)
- CLASSIC or REFORGED
- The cheat's level pick has moved to a LEVEL button
- Multiplayer stops its background work when you're not playing it
- Fixes

Full notes: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/OpenJKDF2-iOS/releases/tag/v0.8-beta2

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Multiplayer finds and connects to the other players' devices on your Wi-Fi network.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Turning the device aims, while gyro aiming is on (hold MENU to set it).
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: The CAMERA button saves its photos to your library.

apps.name: OpenMoTS
apps.developerName: OpenJKDF2 contributors, iOS port by sithewok13-dev
apps.subtitle: Mysteries of the Sith, with touch controls
apps.localizedDescription:
An unofficial fan port of OpenJKDF2 to iPhone and iPad, for the expansion Star Wars Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith (1998). Same engine and touch controls as OpenJKDF2, in a separate app with its own files and saves. It has had less testing than OpenJKDF2.

You need your own copy of the game (GOG or Steam); no game files are included. Open the app once, then copy the game's Episode, Resource and MUSIC folders into Files > On My iPhone > OpenMoTS > mots.

It's a beta: expect bugs, and back up your saves.

Setup guide: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/OpenJKDF2-iOS/blob/HEAD/docs/ios/README.md#mysteries-of-the-sith

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Lucasfilm, Disney or LucasArts, or by the OpenJKDF2 developers.
